members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Add members, set their role and choose the projects each one can reach
members.empty: There are no other members yet

roleHelp.admin: Can do everything, including member management and system settings. Sees every project
roleHelp.developer: Can deploy and edit, only in the selected projects
roleHelp.viewer: Read-only, only in the selected projects

form.usernameHint: 3–64 letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores
form.passwordHint: At least {n} characters. Send it over a secure channel and ask the member to change it on the Account page
form.newPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep the current one. Setting a new password signs the member out everywhere
form.projectsAdmin: An admin already sees every project
form.projectsEmpty: There are no projects to choose from yet
form.selfNote: This is your own account. You cannot change your own role or disable it

confirmDisable.title: Disable {name}
confirmDisable.message: The member is signed out at once and cannot sign in until the account is enabled again. Their data and access stay as they are

confirmDelete.title: Delete member {name}
confirmDelete.message: This permanently deletes the account and cannot be undone. Their history stays in the audit log with the username
